messages:
Alex: Quick check — can we get signoff on the v2 allocator roll to canary? pre-merge perf gate passed unit tests but wanted an extra eyeball before traffic ramp.
Maria: Ran canary load on staging-2. p50 ~= baseline, p95 up ~= 18% and occasional tail spikes ~3s on short-seq requests. Spreadsheet + raw logs posted: https://internal/reports/bench/1802456789
InfraBot: perf-bench finished: artifact: https://internal/artifacts/bench/1802456789.tar.gz. p95 delta: +18%, p99 delta: +40%.
Ryan: Did you run with KV cache warmed? That changes latency a lot for short contexts.
Maria: Re-ran with kv warm, p95 delta reduced to ~8%. With the new fused-attn kernel enabled the variance increased; attaching a quick flamegraph: https://internal/trace/flame-1802456789.svg
Sophie: Sounds like an interaction between the new attention kernel and our continuous-batching window. Short sequences + bigger batching windows = more outliers.
Alex: Ok — let's pause the rollout for now. @eng-runtime can you collect system profiles across canary pods (GPU + thread stacks) for 15m and capture batching stats?
Priya: Kicking off sampling profiler now. Command used:
```
ci/bench --target canary --warm-kv=true --samples=900 --profile=stack --out=artifacts/1802456789
```
Priya: Also enabling per-request tracing on two canary replicas for 10m to correlate tail requests.
Maria: I opened a quick mitigation PR to reduce batching window to 20ms (PR #4521). It trims batching latency but may reduce throughput slightly. Requesting review from @Ryan.
Ryan: Reviewing PR #4521. If that knocks down tail p95 we can re-run the perf gate. If not, prepare rollback plan to v1 allocator.
InfraBot: Canary route report: 6/8 healthy, deploy state: PAUSED by Alex at 1802456812.
Alex: Decision: pause canary and rollback traffic to v1 allocator for this cut. We'll keep v2 branch in staging until profiling completes. I'll notify releases and CS.
Maria: Filing follow-up issue #913 with profiler outputs and initial hypothesis about kernel+batching interaction.
Sophie: Suggest adding a temporary alert on canary p95 > 1.5x baseline for 24h while we root cause.
Alex: Agreed. Please add alert and note in #releases. Thanks all — we'll reconvene after profiling completes and patch validation. :thumbsup:
